key_points: Paramount paid Netflix $2.8B to walk away from the Warner Bros. deal, adding significant cash.
NFLX stock jumped ~14% on the news, signaling market approval.
Morgan Stanley lowered its price target to $80, citing near‑term growth concerns.
Analyst views are mixed: some highlight a new growth engine, others warn of YTD declines and guidance issues.
The cash infusion could bolster content spending and balance‑sheet strength over the coming weeks‑months.
